description: Calculate technical print parameters for a specific lenticular print: print-ready pixel size, uncompressed file size, views per lens period with and without lens rotation, feasibility of a desired view count, and the recommended lens rotation angle. Use this tool when the user asks numerical print questions — how many pixels are needed, what resolution to use, how many views fit, or what rotation angle to use — providing print width and height plus printer DPI, lens LPI, or desired view count when known. The tool computes values from formulas rather than estimating. Scope: numerical print parameters only; it does not produce calibration charts or price quotes.

lpi.description: Lenticular lens pitch in LPI, if known

viewCount.description: Desired number of view frames, if the user has one

name: calculate_output_params
title: Calculate lenticular print output parameters
